Lawn care Templestowe

A lawn program, not just a mow

Most lawns in Templestowe don't need more mowing. They need a plan. Our lawn care programs look after everything that decides how a lawn looks and feels: soil health, feeding, weeds, grubs, pests and disease, as well as the regular cut and a sharp edge.

That's what makes our approach to lawn care in Templestowe different. Dan, our founder, is a qualified horticulturalist. The whole team works the same way: work out why a lawn is thin, patchy or weedy, then fix the cause instead of mowing over it.

You choose one of three levels. Good keeps things healthy and tidy at a 7/10. Great, our specialty, is a 9/10 lawn for house-proud homeowners. Amazing is golf-course quality, our "12 out of 10". Whichever you pick, we schedule the visits and treatments so you don't have to think about it.

Already happy with your lawn mowing in Templestowe but want more from the lawn itself? A program covers the mowing too, so you only deal with one team. If regular lawn mowing in Templestowe is all you need for now, that's fine as well. Many clients start there.

Covered across our lawn programs

  • Mowing and edging on a regular schedule
  • Fertilising to suit your turf and the season
  • Weed control
  • Grub control
  • Soil amendments to fix the soil underneath
  • Pest and disease control

Where we work

Lawn care in Templestowe, Lower Templestowe & surrounds

Templestowe and Lower Templestowe are two of our busiest suburbs. Big established blocks, sloping front yards and plenty of mature trees make lawn care here a real horticultural job. Shade, root competition and heavy soils all need managing, not just mowing.

We also run lawn programs across the rest of Melbourne's north east, from Doncaster and Doncaster East through to Eltham, Greensborough and Mill Park.

FAQ

Lawn Programs FAQs

How much does a lawn care program cost in Templestowe?

It depends on the size and condition of the lawn and the level you choose. As a guide, our indicative pricing for an average 350 m² lawn is about $300–$350 a month (Good), $375–$425 (Great) and $650–$700 (Amazing). We'll give you an exact quote after a look at your lawn.

Is mowing included in the lawn programs?

Yes. Mowing and edging are part of every lawn program, along with feeding, weed and grub control and soil amendments.

Which program should I choose?

If you want a healthy, tidy lawn on a budget, start with Good. If you're house-proud and want the lawn to be a feature, Great is our specialty and our most popular level. If you want golf-course quality, go Amazing. We're happy to recommend one when we quote.

Can I add garden maintenance?

Yes. Lawn and garden programs mix and match. A common combination is the Great Lawn Program with the Good Garden Program. See our garden maintenance programs.

Do you service Lower Templestowe?

Yes, Lower Templestowe is one of our priority suburbs. See our Lower Templestowe lawn care page.
